Quiz 0002 is ready for objective O4. It has six items, mixing multiple choice, numeric and short answer:

- `quizzes/0002.json` holds the questions.
- `keys/0002.json` holds the answers and rationales.

**Coverage:** The items ask who owns the control flow (code or model). They then apply that to makerspace cases: a fixed booking sequence, an open-ended "why is my print warping" question, and a budget comparison in model calls. The last item asks you to correct a teammate who says any system with a model and tools is an agent.

**Source:** The definitions and the cost trade-off come from Anthropic's [Building effective agents](https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/building-effective-agents). I did not add it to `RESOURCES.md`.

**Ahead of the lessons:** There is no lesson on this objective yet, so the quiz checks O4 directly. It uses what you already know about the agent loop from quiz 0001. I can write a lesson next if you want one first.

**Misconception ids:** The key has no `distractors` entries. I couldn't confirm which existing misconception ids apply to these wrong options, and I didn't want to invent new ones. The rationales describe each typical wrong answer in words.

**Unrelated:** Quiz 0001 still has two ungraded submissions, `s1` and `s2`. Do you want me to grade those?
